Join us for a Stargazing Social at The Sawmill!

Spend an evening exploring the night sky as we identify the brightest stars and planets, learn techniques for spotting them, and share fun facts about what we see. We’ll have viewing equipment and night-sky guides available. Jim Kundzicz, our lead expert, will bring his telescope and guide us through celestial highlights, pointing out discoveries and answering questions along the way.

This is a FREE Bay Adventure. Registration is required before the event begins, but you're welcome to drop in anytime during the event to view the night sky.

In the event of cloudy skies, we'll reschedule to Saturday, January 16, 2027, from 6pm - 8:30pm.

Our learning center will be open with access to restrooms and a water fountain.

For more information,
Email: Baptista@savebuzzardsbay.org
